The World

A Realm Worth Losing Yourself In

Every class has its own look, its own story, its own corner of the world. This is a taste of what's waiting.

Getting In

Join the Realm

Three things, in order. The launcher handles the realmlist for you, so you'll only type it once if you ever need to by hand.

STEP ONE

Get the client

Download the Conquest of Azeroth client below and extract it to its own folder. It's a large download, so let it finish fully before moving on.

Download client
STEP TWO

Add the launcher

Drop the Shakiras Descension launcher into the same folder as Ascension.exe. It checks server status and points the game at this realm automatically.

Download launcher
STEP THREE

Press Play

That's the whole thing. If you ever need the realmlist by hand instead:

set realmlist 173.249.46.167

Create your account

Pick your own username and password right now, no waiting on a form. You're in and playing in under a minute.

Create Account
Beyond Vanilla

The Realm's Systems

Shakiras Descension runs dozens of custom systems on top of the base game. Here's what's actually live right now, grouped by what it does for you.

Quality of Life make the grind disappear

Whistle Home

Flightmaster's Whistle

Summons your last-used flight path npc to your side on a cooldown — no more sprinting back to a flight master.

Pocket Portals

Teleport Action Bar

Your collected teleport tokens (Stone of Retreat, Arcane & Balance Tomes) sit on your action bar as one-click spells instead of buried in your bags.

Open Skies

Fly Anywhere

Flying works in the old world — Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor — the moment you have Expert Riding, not just in the expansion zones.

Loot Sweep

AOE Loot

Loot every corpse in a pull with a single click instead of right-clicking each one.

Solo Queue

Solo LFG

Queue for dungeons alone — the system fills the rest of your group for you.

Reagent Vault

Reagent Bank

A dedicated bank tab just for crafting reagents, so they stop eating your bag space.

Progression & Power how you grow

Choose Your Pace

Dynamic XP

Pick your own leveling speed per level range, and the game tells you your current rate when you log in.

Destiny Weaver

Destiny Weaver NPC

A character-specific choice: tune how much the open world scales to your level and control your own experience bonus.

Worldforged Gear

Worldforged Upgrades

Upgrade your gear's item level directly, scaled to the slot and your character's progress — no waiting on a specific drop.

Master of All Trades

Craftsman's Codex

A rare item that unlocks an extra primary profession slot — learn more trades than the vanilla two-profession limit.

Living Spellbook

Spellbook Trainer

The Books of Ascension act as a real class trainer — right-click to open a ranked, level-gated list of your class's abilities and learn on the spot.

Chromie's Prestige

Prestige Mode

Once you've reached the top, ask Chromie to wind back the clock — return to level 1 for a fresh run with prestige standing to show for it.

Path to Ascension

Path to Ascension

A guided in-game tutorial book that tracks your progress through the realm's systems and hands out one-time rewards as you go.

PvP & Combat fight your friends, properly

War Games

Private Arena Matches

Talk to Teri Glozilk to arrange a private, unrated arena match against another group — no queue, no arena points, just bragging rights.

Duelist's Arena

1v1 Arena

A dedicated 1v1 arena queue, separate from the group arena brackets.

Spectator Stands

Arena Spectator

Watch live arena matches from an NPC spectator interface instead of just hearing about the result.

Fresh Start Duels

Duel Reset

Cooldowns reset before a duel starts and come back after it ends, so nobody's fighting with half a kit.

World & Immersion a living realm

Living Weather

Weather Vibe

Zone weather is driven and adjustable — rain, snow, and storms that actually change how a zone feels.

Boss Herald

Boss Announcer

Server-wide announcements when a world boss falls, so you know who just made history.

Hero's Call Board

Call Board / Command Board

Stormwind's Hero's Call Board and Orgrimmar's Warchief's Command Board are fully functional, with daily PvE, profession, and PvP quests.

Trials of Ascension

CoA Challenges

Timed trial content with its own rules, lives, and rewards — a whole secondary game mode layered on top of the realm.

Dungeon Master

Procedural Dungeons

Talk to the Dungeon Master NPC to generate a fresh, level-appropriate dungeon on demand — pick the difficulty and theme yourself.

Ethereal Bazaar

Tiraxis & Bazaar Tokens

A traveling vendor economy built around Bazaar Tokens — a second currency with its own shop.

Hardcore Instances

Dead Means Dead

In dungeons and raids, death carries real weight — opt in for the extra tension if that's your kind of run.

Companions & Trade pets, pals, and gold

Beastmaster

NPC Beastmaster

Adopt and manage hunter-style pets through a dedicated NPC, regardless of your class.

Shapeshifter's Den

Morph & Summon

Cosmetic morph and summon options to change your look or call in a companion, purely for fun.

Transmogrifier

Transmogrification

Make any eligible item look like any other eligible item you've collected the appearance for. Set bonuses stay active either way.

Wandering Enchanter

NPC Enchanter

An NPC that enchants your gear on the spot, no need to track down a player enchanter.

Buff Station

NPC Buffer

One NPC, every raid buff — stop hunting down a dozen class buffers before a pull.

Auctioneer's Network

Auction House Bot

The auction house stays stocked and liquid even when the population is low, so you can always buy or sell.

Living World Bots

Playerbots

Dozens of AI-controlled characters fill out the world — level, quest, trade, and group with real players, so the realm never feels empty.

The Codex

Classes & Specializations

Twenty-one classes across five schools of warfare, each with three or four specs. Tap a chapter to open it, or search for a class, spec, or playstyle below.

Quick Reference

Role Matrix

Every spec in the realm, sorted by the role it fills. A dash means that class has no spec in that column.

ClassTankHealerMelee DPSRanged DPSSupport
